title.en: The Energy Defense Guide: Navigating Low Phases with Spatial Alignment
title.zh-CN: 能量防御指南：如何利用空间布局度过低谷期

description.en: A practical guide to recognizing your low-energy phases and creating stabilizing spatial arrangements. Uses classical environmental algorithms to help you build a protective home sanctuary.
description.zh-CN: 识别你的低能量期并创建稳定空间布局的实用指南。运用经典环境算法帮助你打造防护型居家避风港。

title.en: Quantum Space: Harmonizing Your Home with Classical Energy Principles
title.zh-CN: 量子空间：用经典能量原理调和你的家

description.en: Explore how classical Five Element principles can inform modern interior design. Learn to create rooms that support your personal energy catalyst through color, texture, and spatial arrangement.
description.zh-CN: 探索经典五行原则如何指导现代室内设计。学习通过色彩、材质与空间布局创建支持个人能量催化剂的房间。

title.en: Energy Rhythm Journal — Five Elements Edition
title.zh-CN: 能量节律日记本 · 五行版

description.en: A guided journal for daily energy reflection, organized by the Five Elemental Balance System. Track your personal rhythm cycles and identify seasonal patterns.
description.zh-CN: 按五行平衡系统组织的每日能量反思日记本。追踪你的个人节律周期，识别季节性模式。

title.en: Chronobiological Rhythms: A Modern Guide to Seasonal Energy Mapping
title.zh-CN: 时间生物节律：季节能量图谱的现代指南

description.en: A 6-hour course covering how ancient environmental systems mapped human physiology to seasonal and temporal changes — translated into modern energy cycle metrics and actionable lifestyle strategies.
description.zh-CN: 6 小时课程，涵盖古代环境系统如何将人类生理映射到季节与时间变化——转化为现代能量周期指标与可执行的生活策略。
